future_interface: The fold-local PCA terrain latent is a simple encoder baseline and may later be replaced by CART, a world model, or another learned terrain representation without changing w->beta Objective Selector semantics.
interpretation_guard: TRAIN-context LOCO only. No validation/test/hard rough seed is used. This is not final selector fitting.
next_stage: Compare against the original T5.5e1 5D-selector LOCO. Proceed to final TRAIN fit and external held-out validation only if cross-context physical score generalization improves meaningfully.
physical_evaluation: Continuous predicted lambda is projected to the nearest frozen 21-point beta lattice, then evaluated using the original frozen T5.5d context-local Pareto scalarization.
selector_semantics: [fold-local terrain latent z_T, friction mu, physical mission preference w] -> lambda -> beta = 0.15 + 0.55 lambda

terrain_representation.k_selection: smallest fold-local PCA dimension with >=95% explained rough-patch variance
terrain_representation.pca_fit_context_type: rough TRAIN contexts excluding held rough context
